title: SAMVAD: A Multi-Agent System for Simulating Judicial Deliberation Dynamics in India
reasoning: The paper focuses on simulating legal reasoning and judicial deliberation within the Indian legal system using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Multi-Agent Systems. While it mentions the goal of assessing the fairness of justice systems, the evaluation centers on legal grounding, consensus, and consistency with authoritative legal texts (like the IPC and Constitution) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
